fields.meta_title: Uniform Order Form Builder for Teams and Staff | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Take orders on a uniform order form for a team or a staff, give each player one jersey number, and add every size into one supplier order.
fields.h1: Build a Uniform Order Form That Totals Every Size
fields.hero_description: Get a uniform order form that collects sizes and jersey numbers, then totals every size for your supplier.
fields.features_heading: What Happens to Each Uniform Order
fields.features_subheading: A clipboard of sizes still has to be counted by hand and retyped for the supplier. These six parts do that work as each order arrives.
fields.feature_1:
Every garment with its own size run

List each item with its price and its sizes, such as youth small up to adult 2XL. Buyers pick a size and a quantity, and the form shows the total on screen before they submit.
fields.feature_2:
One jersey number per player

Players choose from the numbers still open. A number leaves the picker as soon as one player claims it, and the coach sees every number in use, by player, on a single screen.
fields.feature_3:
Names on the back, spelled as typed

Ask for the name to print on each jersey, and show it to the buyer on a review screen before they submit. The print list for the supplier comes straight from the saved orders.
fields.feature_4:
Totals by size when ordering closes

Set a close date, and the app counts every item by size and color once that date passes. The count goes to whoever places the supplier order, by email or in a Slack message.
fields.feature_5:
Allowances and approvals for staff

Give each employee a yearly uniform allowance. An order inside it goes straight through. An order past it waits for a manager's approval, and the manager gets an email about it.
fields.feature_6:
Orders saved to a database you own

Every order saves as a row in a database you own, and responses have no cap. Next season's order can start from this season's saved rows instead of a blank sheet of sizes.

fields.usecase_heading: Teams and Staff, Four Uniform Orders
fields.tab_content_1:
Each jersey number goes to one player only

Cedar Hollow Mudcats play 12U baseball, and each player picks a jersey number along with a jersey size. Once a number is taken, it drops off the list for the next family. When the 13th player orders, team manager Dale Whitcomb gets an email with every number and size on the roster.
fields.tab_content_2:
Sizes add up to 22 jerseys for the supplier

Northgate Hoops runs one order window for its 14U team, and it closes on September 20. The app then counts the jerseys by size: 4 youth medium, 7 youth large, 6 adult small, and 5 adult medium, or 22 in all. Club director Imani Beckett gets the totals in a Slack direct message.
fields.tab_content_3:
A manager approves any order past $150

Halvorsen Plumbing gives each technician $150 a year for work shirts and jackets. Wes Arland orders 4 shirts at $24 and a jacket at $90, a total of $186 that runs $36 over the $150 allowance. His order waits, and operations manager Corinne Tash gets an email asking her to approve it.
fields.tab_content_4:
New hires get a reminder when their order is missing

New hires at the Larkspur Hotel order their uniforms 5 days before the first shift. Tamsin Royce starts on Monday and has not ordered, so she gets a reminder email with the link. HR coordinator Joel Brannigan sees her on the missing list, next to 4 new hires who have ordered.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Uniform Order Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to set up a uniform order form that gets every size right and hands your supplier one count to order from.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Get the size chart from your supplier
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Decide who orders, and for whom
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Set the rules for numbers and names
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Add the allowance or the payment
fields.howto_step_1_des: Ask your supplier for the size chart and the price of each item, including any extra charge for larger sizes. Use their size labels, such as YM or AL. The count you send back then matches their order sheet line for line.
fields.howto_step_2_des: On a team form, a parent places one order per player, and the player's name is the main field. On a staff form, tie each order to an employee name or ID that matches the payroll list.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Pick the jersey number range and decide whether a returning player keeps last season's number. If names go on the back, set a character limit that fits the print area and show the name on the review screen.
fields.howto_step_4_des: For staff, enter the yearly allowance and the manager who approves an order past it. For a team, decide whether families pay with the order or the club pays the supplier, and record which it is on every order.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Pick a close date that fits the supplier
fields.howto_step_5_des: Count back from the day you need uniforms in hand, and leave room for the supplier's production time. Close the form on that date, and place the supplier order the next morning.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Submit 3 orders yourself before sharing the link: one in the smallest size, one with a name on the back, and one that tests your number or allowance rule. Check that each one shows up in the size totals.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Share the link and track who is missing
fields.howto_step_7_des: Send the link to the team or staff list, then compare the orders with the roster a few days before the close date. Remind anyone missing, because a late size can mean a second supplier order.

faq_plan.q: What is a uniform order form?
faq_plan.a: A uniform order form is the form a team or an employer uses to collect uniform orders. Each order records who it is for, what they need in which size, and any name or number to print, and the orders add up into one order for the supplier.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a uniform order form?
faq_plan.ref: how do i create a uniform order form
faq_plan.a: Start with your supplier's size chart, then add fields for the person, the garments and sizes, and the print details. In Emergent's AI form builder, describe the order in one prompt, such as "jerseys at $30, sizes YS to AXL, one number per player," and Emergent returns a working form with a database for every order.

faq_plan.q: What fields should a team uniform order form include?
faq_plan.a: It should include the player's name, a size for each item, the jersey number, and the name to print on the back if the team prints names. Add a parent's email for the confirmation, and ask whether the player is returning, since a returning player may want last season's number.

faq_plan.q: Where can I find a uniform order form template?
faq_plan.a: Jotform and SurveyMonkey both publish one. SurveyMonkey's template has fields for size, color, customization details, quantity, and delivery preferences, and Jotform's can be customized to meet specific requirements. Pick the one that gives every item its own size field. If every item comes in one size, a plain order form is the simpler place to start.

faq_plan.q: What sizes should a baseball uniform order form collect?
faq_plan.a: Ask for a jersey size, a pants size, and a cap size for each player. Keep them as three separate fields rather than one size per player. Put the jersey number in the same order, and add socks or a belt only when the team buys them.

faq_plan.q: Can I turn a baseball uniform order form template into an online form?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Paste the template's columns into a prompt, add the jersey prices and your rule for numbers, and Emergent builds an online version with the same fields. Each order lands as a row you can sort by number or by size.

faq_plan.q: What fields go on a basketball uniform order form?
faq_plan.a: It needs a jersey size, a shorts size, and the jersey number for each player, plus the name for the back when the club prints one. When the jerseys already exist and only need names pressed on, that job goes to the print shop on a work order form instead. For a reversible set, treat the jersey as one item with one size.

faq_plan.q: What should a basketball uniform order form template leave room for?
faq_plan.a: Leave room for a name line with a character limit, a jersey number, and separate jersey and shorts sizes. Add a line for a second set if the team plays in home and away colors. A template with one size field per player makes a parent pick one size for two garments.

faq_plan.q: How do you set up allowances on a company uniform order form?
faq_plan.a: Give each employee a yearly allowance on the form and compare every order with it. An order inside the allowance goes through, and one past it waits for a manager. With Emergent, the manager hears about a held order by email, and there are no per-approver seats to pay for.

faq_plan.q: What should an employee uniform order form collect?
faq_plan.a: It should collect the employee's name or ID, the department, every garment with a size and quantity, and the start date for a new hire. Use the supplier's size labels, because the totals by item and size become the purchase order form sent to the uniform supplier. Show the allowance balance if the company pays up to a limit.

plan.angle: The top 10 is template galleries (Jotform, SurveyMonkey, template.net, Neartail, Fillout) and shared Google and Microsoft forms. Each one stops at collecting a size and a quantity. This page shows what a coach or an office manager does after the orders come in: hand out jersey numbers without two players on the same number, add every size into one order for the supplier, hold a staff order that runs over its allowance for a manager, and chase a new hire who has not ordered before the first shift. Four buyers a searcher will recognize: a youth baseball team, a basketball club, a plumbing company, and a hotel hiring new staff. The FAQ answers the definition, how to build one, and the team, template, baseball, basketball, company and employee versions.
